customerJourneyChange.title: Guided customer protection journey
customerJourneyChange.rootCause: The post-sign-in control plane exposed specialist projects, policies, keys, approvals and terminal integration steps before giving an ordinary customer a clear goal or next action.
customerJourneyChange.controlOutcome: The default view now presents one recommended next action and a browser-run synthetic protection check, while retaining advanced controls behind explicit progressive disclosure.
customerJourneyChange.usageDisclosure: Each guided run consumes four monthly protection checks.
customerJourneyChange.evidenceBoundary: Guided events are synthetic, labelled guided_demo and excluded from customer integration and deployment-readiness evidence.

focusedGuidedJourneyGate.command: NODE_ENV=test node --test tests/access-control.test.js tests/runtime-policy.test.js tests/control-plane.test.js tests/customer-journey.test.js

detectionBenchmark.scope: Small internal synthetic English regression set; not independent or production-representative.

limitations: The automated gate used isolated local test persistence and did not connect to the production PostgreSQL service.
No Render deployment, live authenticated customer journey, live payment or production email was performed in this environment.
Automated screenshot rendering was unavailable because local browser navigation was blocked by administrator policy.
The guided check proves the hosted synthetic decision path, not customer integration or direct-tool network containment.
Internal engineering validation is not independent usability research, penetration testing, accredited certification or a guarantee that the system is risk-free.
liveVerificationRequired: Verify /api/ready reports version 9.3.0, production stage and healthy PostgreSQL with migration 008 current.
Verify an ordinary authenticated owner lands on the guided control-plane view.
Run the safe protection check and confirm missing approval denied, changed amount denied, exact action allowed once and replay denied.
Verify the browser receives no project API key or approval bearer token from the guided route.
Verify the published customer policy remains unchanged and guided_demo events do not satisfy deployment readiness.
Verify Technical controls preserve policy, key, inventory, remediation, approval and audit workflows.
Perform desktop and mobile visual checks and review logs, usage, monitoring and rollback readiness.
